method: Frozen 1000 iid weighted-mask-grid point draws; 97.5% marginal Wilson intervals for red and survey membership; Bonferroni approximate >=95% simultaneous sampling coverage; evaluate four feasible rectangle corners with epoch-stratified set bounds.
scientific_interpretation: Previously quoted 59.488%-59.544% conditional nominal interval is too precise to be treated as a final uncertainty range. Even under fixed raster and iid sample assumptions, approximate 95% simultaneous sample uncertainty widens it to 59.389%-59.637%. Without MC spatial allocation, nominal 30mas tile-sum mask cap alone permits 58.371%-61.109%. Both still exclude systematic errors.
limitations: Sampling confidence is conditional on fixed raster mask and assumed iid weighted draws; not a full 95% scientific CI.
0.6arcsec raster union upper is approximate, not a strict sky bound.
30mas native tile-sum area is nominal, not independently validated with per-pixel TAN WCS determinant.
3.6arcsec WHT phase sampling and ~0.96% raster deposition losses are not propagated.
No direct WHT-star-mask spatial intersection, calibrated F444W=26.2 selection area, or F356W astrometric completeness.
No re-download of large WHT or user-supplied star mask was attempted.
